subject: computer-science

items.q: What does a WHILE loop do?
items.correct: Repeats while a condition stays true.
items.why: WHILE repeats until its condition is false; FOR repeats a set number of times; infinite loops are a bug.

items.q: Can a variable's value change while a program runs?
items.correct: Yes — variables can be reassigned; constants stay fixed.
items.misconception: No, a variable keeps one value throughout.
items.why: Variables are named stores whose value can change; constants are fixed.

items.q: What is the difference between '=' and '==' in many languages?
items.correct: '=' assigns a value; '==' tests if two values are equal.
items.why: Assignment puts a value into a variable; the comparison operator checks equality and returns true/false.
